title: Neumorphic Input
summary: A text field carved into the surface.
description: Inset shadows make the field look pressed in, and the focus state deepens them rather than adding an outline.
accessibility_notes: Placeholder text must still hit 4.5:1 against the surface; the focus state adds a coloured ring because shadow depth alone is not perceivable for many users.
variations: Error state with a red inset glow
ai_usage: Soft-UI forms. Combine the inset well with a real focus ring — neumorphic focus states are the single most common accessibility failure in this style.
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Neumorphic Input</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "neumorphic-input",
    "title": "Neumorphic Input",
    "summary": "A text field carved into the surface.",
    "description": "Inset shadows make the field look pressed in, and the focus state deepens them rather than adding an outline.",
    "theme": "glass-neumorphism",
    "categories": ["neumorphism", "form"],
    "tags": ["neumorphism", "input", "inset", "soft-ui", "form"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "2020s",
    "difficulty": "intermediate",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "Placeholder text must still hit 4.5:1 against the surface; the focus state adds a coloured ring because shadow depth alone is not perceivable for many users.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--bg", "description": "Surface", "default": "#232a3a" },
      { "name": "--accent", "description": "Focus colour", "default": "#7c5cff" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Icon inside the well", "Light-mode palette", "Error state with a red inset glow"],
    "ai_usage": "Soft-UI forms. Combine the inset well with a real focus ring — neumorphic focus states are the single most common accessibility failure in this style."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    body { background: #232a3a; }
    :root { --bg: #232a3a; --accent: #7c5cff; }
    .ni { width: 260px; padding: .95rem 1.1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--bg); color: #e7ebf3;
      font: inherit; box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 9px rgba(0,0,0,.5), inset -4px -4px 9px rgba(255,255,255,.05); }
    .ni::placeholder { color: #8b93a7; }
    .ni:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <input class="ni" type="text" placeholder="Search projects" aria-label="Search projects" />
</body>
</html>
